name: Glass Jar
northStar: The jar is the hero: you watch it rise on the page, and the lid tells you when.

engine.source: A glass jar of starter on a floury counter in morning light.
engine.evidence: Every buyer already owns the jar; the product is the lid that finally makes it talk.

tone._why: Calm kitchen product, crafted, lots of air.

skeleton: The product is the page: a large drawn jar centered, its level line live with a peak marker; headline left of the jar, the phone notification right of it; one CTA under the jar.

color.from: Flour, glass and the amber of a well-fed rye starter.

hero: A drawn jar with a live rise line.
controls: Pill CTA only; everything else is text.
